def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # object = connected non-zero region containing most cells; 5s not connected to it are markers
    from scipy.ndimage import label
    mask=[[1 if g[i][j]!=0 else 0 for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    lab,n=label(mask)
    sizes=[( (lab==k).sum(),k) for k in range(1,n+1)]
    sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    main=sizes[0][1]
    obj=[(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if lab[i][j]==main]
    obj5=[(i,j) for i,j,v in obj if v==5]
